subject: Delegated sandbox provisioning & ops handover — rollout plan
messages:
From: Ethan Glass <ethan@clearwell.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearwell.com
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox access for three new product teams — timeline?

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for last week's run-through. We're ready to expand the pilot: three additional product teams (Search, Clinical Rules, and Ingestion) need sandbox credentials and a delegated ops handover so each team can spin up their own dev projects without involving our infra squad for every key.

High level asks:
- 3 project-specific API keys (one per team) scoped to dev-only access
- Sandbox quota per project: ~100k tokens/day for the first month, with ability to raise to 500k by month 2
- An ops handover document with on-call steps for common failures and a short runbook for token/usage troubleshooting

What's your earliest ETA for provisioning + a short handoff call next week? Procurement will likely need an updated SOW for signatures.

Ethan
Ethan Glass
Head of Platform 
Clearwell Health

--
Attachment: Clearwell_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Glass <ethan@clearwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox access for three new product teams — timeline?

Thanks Ethan — great to hear the pilot momentum. We can absolutely support three dev projects with delegated keys and an ops runbook. Outline below is what I suggest as a minimum to keep everything secure and predictable during ramp:  

Plan (week-by-week):
- Day 0–2: Issue three scoped dev API keys (dev-only, no production write policies). Keys rotate every 90 days by default but we can set a 30-day rotation for the pilot if you prefer.
- Day 2–5: Provision sandbox capacity and set per-key quotas: start at 100k tokens/day, with an autoscale policy to bump to 500k within 48 hours when threshold is reached (we'll pre-approve bursts for the first two weeks).
- Day 3: Delivery of ops_runbook_draft.md + short video walkthrough (10–12 minutes).
- Day 5–7: 30-minute handover call with your dev leads + our CS/ops (we'll cover incident playbook, KV cache behavior, and cost telemetry).

Attachments I will send for procurement: SOW_clearwell_draft.pdf and a quick MAP spreadsheet showing committed vs burst billing. Can Marissa or Laura flag anything I should include in the SOW re: SLA or data retention?

If that timeline works I can start issuing keys as soon as procurement confirms the SOW sign-off. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Dylan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0193

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox access for three new product teams — timeline?

Looping in Priyom for ops acceptance and default commit guidance. A couple of quick items from procurement/finance POV:
- We should propose a one-month trial at the committed 100k/day with optional conversion to a 3-month minimal commit if usage patterns look steady. That reduces procurement friction.
- Include a line item for burst credits (pre-approved for first 2 weeks) to avoid throttling during onboarding.

Priyom — can your team validate the autoscale thresholds and confirm we can enable per-key quota caps from the private control plane? Also we need an ops-handoff template: short runbook + escalation matrix (on-call list, pager channels).

-Marissa
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox access for three new product teams — timeline?

All — quick ops confirmation:
- We can create three scoped API keys tied to dev sandboxes. Keys will be labeled clearwell-search-dev, clearwell-rules-dev, clearwell-ingest-dev.
- Default quota: 100k tokens/day. Autoscale policy: when a key hits 85% of quota for two consecutive 6-hour windows, allow a single automated upshift to 500k/day (with rate-limit ramp to avoid sudden P99 latency spikes).
- We will publish ops_runbook_draft.md with troubleshooting steps (cache warm, token exhaustion, model fallback) and an escalation matrix. I will attach the runbook v0.9 to this thread.

Two asks from ops:
1) Can Clearwell provide the intended traffic patterns (typical prompt lengths, average tokens per call) so we can tune batching and KV caching?
2) Confirm whether teams want cross-project prefix caching (shared KV cache) or isolated caches per project. Isolated is safer but may increase token costs.

I'll add the runbook to the shared Drive folder and will schedule the handover call for Friday (Mar 23) at 10:00am PT unless you propose otherwise.

—Priyom
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: ops_runbook_draft.md (text)

Thanks all — that schedule works. A few confirmations from Clearwell: 
- We'll share traffic profiles by EOD Monday (typical prompt ~120 tokens, avg response ~340 tokens).
- Teams prefer isolated caches for now.
- Procurement confirmed they need a signed SOW and a short amendment to our master agreement for the 30-day trial. Maria (cc'd) will route a DocuSign link once you attach the SOW draft.

Dylan — can you send the SOW_clearwell_draft.pdf and I will kick off signatures? Also please include the MAP spreadsheet so procurement can see estimated overage/burst costs. Looking forward to the handover call Friday.

Ethan
